column7: Builds a granted token from the token endpoint answer; the oversized expires_in refusal lives in refuse_oversized_expires_in

Refuses a token request, refresh or code exchange before discovery has run (no authorization-server metadata), before anything is sent; pinned by a_grant_before_initialize_is_refused_as_not_initialized
Returns "<redacted>" or "None" for an optional secret in three Debug impls; a mistake would silently leak the OAuth token or client secret into logs
